name: m6-test-seams-agreement
description: Test planning uses agreed public seams, vertical slices and justified refactoring
checks: test-seams.md routed on test planning; engineering.md section 5 preserved
turns: Aplica la guía de seams de pruebas de Metodología. Para leer las instrucciones locales usa únicamente Read, Glob o Grep; no uses shell, escribas archivos, ejecutes aplicaciones, instales nada ni delegues. Solo analiza: en un módulo de pedidos, OrderService usa internamente PriceCalculator y TaxClient (API externa de impuestos). Quiero añadir descuentos por volumen. Dame el plan de pruebas: dónde se prueba, en qué orden, qué se simula y si hace falta refactorizar. Ya aprobé trabajar de forma autónoma; no hace falta preguntar por cada prueba.

graders.name: seams-slices-mocks-refactor
graders.criteria: PASS only if the plan (1) tests through the public OrderService interface as the agreed seam and states what that seam catches and what it misses; (2) works in vertical slices, one failing test then minimal code, not all tests first; (3) simulates only the external tax API (system boundary) and does not mock PriceCalculator or other internal collaborators; (4) takes expected values from independent literals or worked examples, not by recomputing the formula; (5) refactors only if needed, in a separate behaviour-preserving step, and neither requires a refactor phase nor defers all refactoring to review; (6) does not ask the owner to approve every test or seam, but records the seam choice as a plan assumption.
